title: Covered Metal Stent for Benign Biliary Stricture Caused by Chronic Pancreatitis
brief_summary: Benign biliary strictures caused by chronic pancreatitis can be endoscopically treated with covered self-expandable metal stents (cSEMS).The purpose of the prospective randomized study is to define the optimal duration of stenting and the diameter of the cSEMS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Benign biliary stricture caused by chronic pancreatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Malignancy, cirrhosis, acute/chronic hepatitis or abnormal hepatic imaging. First attack of acute pancreatitis
